stem.text: The diagram shows the electric field near a positively charged sphere and a negatively charged sphere.
Four electrons **A**, **B**, **C** and **D** are shown at different positions in the field.
On which electron is the direction of the force on the electron shown correctly?

stem.alt: Electric field-line diagram around a positively charged sphere (+) on the left and a negatively charged sphere (−) on the right. Four points labelled A, B, C and D are marked in the field, each with an arrow drawn beside it.
